protocol.purpose: Within-device controlled diagnostic; no scheduler and no historical-cause attribution

input_generation.distribution: standard_normal(shape=(N,N), dtype=numpy.float32); A then B from the same context-specific stream
input_generation.dtype_conversion: Generate float32 on CPU, cast once to context dtype on CPU, hash exact contiguous post-cast CPU bytes
input_generation.placement: Generate all four context input pairs on CPU first, then copy each pair to CUDA once; reuse the same tensors in every phase
input_generation.cross_device_identity: Verify A/B SHA256 rather than assume version-independent normal sampling

protocol.operator: torch.mm(A, B) returning a newly allocated output; no out= argument

measurement.timer: CUDA start/end Events; synchronize end Event; elapsed_ms divided by 10

precision_api.selection: PyTorch >=2.9 with both new properties uses new API; otherwise legacy; never mix in one process
precision_api.other_settings: Snapshot existing FP16/BF16 reduced-precision reduction and accumulation settings; assert unchanged throughout

protocol.environment_override_policy: Abort before CUDA work if NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE or TORCH_ALLOW_TF32_CUBLAS_OVERRIDE is nonempty; do not modify either

outputs.matrix_retention: No full output matrices written; first output of each mode retained in CPU RAM only until paired difference is calculated
outputs.delta: CPU float64 chunked Frobenius norm of C_on-C_off divided by norm(C_off); check finite values and positive denominator; C_off is reference, not mathematical truth
outputs.repeated_phase: Record output hash and finiteness; do not replace first paired output

estimands.mode_time: geometric mean of stage medians when a mode appears twice; direct stage median otherwise
estimands.descriptive_scope: Report all three round-level R and recovery ratios; windows are within-round stability observations, not independent hardware replicates; no post-hoc deletion or significance threshold

protocol.telemetry: nvidia-smi read-only snapshots before and after each phase; record failures and external compute PIDs without killing processes
protocol.smoke: Separate smoke_round_XX output directory; same four contexts but 2 warmup calls, 1 window and 1 call; not formal data; do not use effect size to choose contexts
protocol.failure_policy: Incrementally flush CSV/status/telemetry. Preserve every failed or interfered round, never overwrite an existing round directory. Any rerun uses a separate output root and an explicit reason.
